findings.evidence: Lines 173–174 construct `AlgEquiv.ofBijective (AlgHom.mulLeftRight K A)` solely from `mulLeftRight_bijective`; Mathlib `Algebra/Azumaya/Defs.lean:61` already stores exactly this bijectivity as `IsAzumaya.bij`, and lines 194–196 merely compose that equivalence with the general `endAlgEquivMatrix`.
findings.fix: Define the equivalence and computation lemma first under `[IsAzumaya K A]`, using `IsAzumaya.bij`; derive the central-simple API by locally installing `TauCeti.IsSimpleRing.isAzumaya K A` or by thin wrappers.
findings.issue: `tensorOpAlgEquivEnd`, its application lemma, and consequently `tensorOpAlgEquivMatrix` require `[Algebra.IsCentral K A] [IsSimpleRing A] [FiniteDimensional K A]`, although the construction only needs `[IsAzumaya K A]` (with finite-dimensionality following over a field).

summary: The Azumaya-to-endomorphism and matrix equivalences are stated only for central simple algebras, although their construction naturally applies to any Azumaya algebra.
